verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents its own case management queue. Analysts can prioritise, filter (by customer risk, stage, assignee, date) and decide on alerts. Transactions run through transaction monitoring, which produces transaction-monitoring cases and alerts, and high-risk cases are escalated for human review. Each case also has an audit trail. However, the evidence never shows the queue presenting the rich context the story asks for. missing for 10: evidence that the review view surfaces customer history, risk signals/explanations and similar cases alongside the flagged transaction, plus any hands-on corroboration of review speed or consistency.
